name: setup
description: Start PWM on a pin at a frequency in Hz with duty 0, returns the frequency reached or 0 (pin,frequency)->(actual)

name: duty
description: Set the duty cycle to value/max (pin,value,max)->()

description: Stop PWM on a pin and drive it low (pin)->()
